Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Manager position at Ideal Systems. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and web management, I am excited about the opportunity to build your brand and drive visibility in the B2B SaaS space.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites—skills that translate directly to producing sales materials and maintaining your websites. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to execute end-to-end marketing tasks, from technical audits to social media integration.

I am a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments, and I am eager to bring my Canva and LinkedIn skills to create consistent, on-brand content. I am comfortable reaching out to customers to capture their stories and have a foundational understanding of Google Ads and email marketing tools.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for hybrid work in Vilvoorde. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Ideal Systems' growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Manager position at Ideal Systems. Your mission to bring CCaaS platforms to mobile workforces is impressive, and I am drawn to the opportunity to be your first dedicated marketing hire—shaping your brand from the ground up.

With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web design, I have developed a versatile skill set that aligns with your needs. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. These experiences have honed my ability to produce clean, clear copy and create visually appealing assets—skills essential for crafting one-pagers, product sheets, and social posts.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my initiative and technical acumen. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data for AI search visibility, and integrated social media—all while maintaining a consistent brand voice. This project taught me to move from idea to execution quickly, a trait you value.

I am comfortable working with customers to tell their stories, as I have experience coordinating content and understanding user needs. While I am still growing in Google Ads and email marketing, I am eager to master these tools and have a solid foundation in analytics to guide campaigns.

As a self-starter, I thrive in environments where I can take ownership and see immediate results. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am excited about the hybrid setup in Vilvoorde. I am confident that my blend of technical and creative skills will help Ideal Systems grow its visibility and support Sales effectively.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
